review_candidates.title: Zoho Developer
review_candidates.description: About Us Blue Ocean Corporation is a leading conglomerate and world leader in driving continuous growth and transformation across a multitude of industries and sectors. Our commitment to quality, innovation, and client satisfaction has propelled us to the forefront of the Consulting, Training and Conferences landscapes. From our humble beginnings to our present status as a global market leader, we take pride in our global footprint, and the transformative impact we have had on industries. With over 25+ years of excellence in accelerating careers and transforming organizations, we are a trusted partner for our B2B and B2C clients. Job Description Develop, maintain, and enhance software applications and internal business solutions based on organizational requirements. Design, develop, test, debug, and maintain applications using programming languages such as Python, Java, JavaScript, Deluge, C, C++, or other relevant technologies. Develop and customize solutions across the Zoho ecosystem, including Zoho CRM, Zoho People, Zoho Recruit, Zoho Creator, Zoho Analytics, and other Zoho applications as required. Develop and maintain custom workflows, functions, integrations, automations, and business processes using Zoho Deluge and APIs. Integrate Zoho applications with internal systems, third-party applications, websites, and other business platforms. Provide technical support and troubleshoot application, software, hardware, system, and integration-related issues. Work with databases, SQL queries, data structures, and database management concepts to support application development and reporting requirements. Manage system data, backups, documentation, access controls, and technical records in accordance with organizational policies. Assist with website development, maintenance, database updates, internal tools, and other technology initiatives as required. Analyze business and technical requirements and translate them into effective software and automation solutions. Conduct application testing, debugging, performance improvements, and issue resolution to ensure system reliability and functionality. Provide technical guidance and hands-on support to internal users on software applications, Zoho platforms, and other business systems. Train and guide employees on the effective use of software applications and technology solutions implemented within the organization. Collaborate with senior IT and software engineering team members on development projects, system enhancements, integrations, and implementations. Stay updated with emerging technologies, software development practices, Zoho product updates, and automation capabilities. Ensure compliance with IT policies, information security standards, data protection requirements, and software development best practices. Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related field. 1–2 years of professional experience in software development, application development, or a related software engineering role. Minimum 2 years of hands-on experience working with Zoho applications is required. Strong proficiency in at least one programming language such as Python, Java, JavaScript, Deluge, Apex, C, or C++. Hands-on experience with Zoho CRM, Zoho Creator, Zoho People, Zoho Recruit, Zoho Analytics, or other Zoho applications will be highly preferred. Strong knowledge of Zoho Deluge, workflows, custom functions, APIs, and system integrations. Good understanding of SQL, relational databases, database concepts, and data management. Knowledge of REST APIs, web services, application integrations, and automation tools is preferred. Good understanding of operating systems, networking fundamentals, troubleshooting, and IT infrastructure. Ability to analyze technical issues, troubleshoot problems, and develop practical solutions independently. Strong communication, collaboration, problem-solving, and analytical skills. Good presentation and technical training skills, with the ability to explain software and technical concepts to non-technical users. Strong willingness to learn new technologies, platforms, programming languages, and business applications. Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams and support multiple technical requirements in a fast-paced environment. check(event) ; career-website-detail-template-2 => apply(record.id,meta)" mousedown="lyte-button => check(event)" final-style="background-color:#6875E2;border-color:#6875E2;color:white;" final-class="lyte-button lyteBackgroundColorBtn lyteSuccess" lyte-rendered="">

review_candidates.title: Technical Sales Representative
review_candidates.company: Royal Coating for Paints & Chemical Industries
review_candidates.description: TECHNICAL SALES REPRESENTATIVE — COATINGS Royal Coating for Paints & Chemical Industries 6th of October, Giza. Full-time. Field-based. ABOUT THE COMPANY Royal Coating for Paints & Chemical Industries manufactures automotive refinish, industrial, wood and car care coatings. We supply body shops, industrial customers, contractors, distributors and finishing professionals across Egypt and export markets, with products sold as complete coating systems supported by technical guidance. ABOUT THE ROLE We are building our technical sales function and are looking for a strong salesperson first. The coatings knowledge is what we train. You will be in the field most of the week, working directly with workshops, industrial customers and distributors: opening new accounts, growing existing ones, running product demonstrations, managing samples and trials, and supporting customers through app lication. RESPONSIBILITIES Regular field visits to body shops, service centres, industrial customers and distributors within an assigned territory. Open new accounts and grow volume with existing customers. Understand each customer's technical and commercial requirement, and recommend the appropriate system. Conduct product demonstrations, place samples and follow trials through to a documented outcome. Support the launch of new products and the development of slower moving lines. Coordinate with technical and production teams to ensure product recommendations are accurate. Follow up on quotations, orders and deliveries. Maintain accurate records of visits, opportunities and customer interactions. Report market intelligence: competitor activity, pricing, customer requirements. Attend training, market visits and industry events. Work within company technical, commercial and occupational safety policies. REQUIREMENTS Proven experience in field sales or technical sales, B2B. Coatings background is an advantage but not required. Demonstrable record of meeting targets and opening new accounts. Ability to build credibility with technical customers. Genuine willingness to learn the technical side in depth. Strong negotiation, presentation and communication skills. Ability to explain and teach. Much of this role is educating customers on correct application. Arabic fluency. English sufficient to read technical data sheets. Competent with email, spreadsheets and CRM systems. Valid driving licence and willingness to travel to customer sites. Bachelor’s degree in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Materials Science, Business or a related field is preferred, not essential. TRAINING We provide a structured technical training programme covering the product system, application stages, defect diagnosis and safety standards, regardless of prior coatings experience, with ongoing technical support in the field. WHAT WE LOOK FOR Honesty with customers, professional respect, commitment to safety standards, and the ability to build long term relationships based on trust rather than price alone. PACKAGE Base salary plus commission, with transport allowance, under a defined performance structure.
